mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.plate_no AS plateNo, e.plate_color AS plateColor, e.space_no AS spaceNo, e.enter_time AS enterTime, e.record_type AS recordType, e.status AS status, s.name AS stationName, e.remark, e.proof_image AS proofImage, e.is_corrected AS isCorrected, e.reserve1, e.reserve2, e.creator, e.updater, e.create_time AS createTime, e.update_time AS updateTime FROM enter_record e LEFT JOIN station_info s ON e.station_id = s.id WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.deleted = 0
